# Golden Topaz

Golden Topaz applies a warm, golden palette to Obsidian for a calm, focused visual atmosphere. The recorded description credits refined syntax highlighting and clearer table and chart colors with improving readability, and mentions reworked graph and editor visuals.

![Golden Topaz screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shaggyfeng/obsidian-Golden-Topaz-theme/HEAD/screenshot.png)

    name:   "Golden Topaz"
    author: "shaggyfeng"
    repo:   "shaggyfeng/obsidian-Golden-Topaz-theme"
    slug:   "golden-topaz"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/golden-topaz"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]

}
